data.name: Ameyatma
data.gender_notes: Ameyatma is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ameyatma is a compound name derived from two Sanskrit words: ‘Ameya’ meaning ‘immortal’ and ‘Atma’ meaning ‘soul’. The name signifies the eternal soul that exists beyond physical life. The name Ameyatma carries the meaning “Immortal Soul” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ameyatma usually hope their child will grow to embody immortal soul and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the immortal soul that transcends the physical world.
data.etymology: Ameyatma belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Immortal Soul.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ameyatma total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
